questarrng.name: QuestarrNG
questarrng.description: Questarr fork for SeerrNG game requests, acquisition tracking, and imported-file delivery.
questarrng.longDescription: QuestarrNG is a maintained fork of Questarr for SeerrNG. It retains upstream game discovery and acquisition while adding a versioned request API with durable request and download correlation, OS and architecture variants, and authenticated access to verified imported files. SeerrNG remains the user-facing catalog, approval, and request experience.
